svg.title: Foundation ground beam — Sökkulbiti milli undirstaðna
svg.desc: A reinforced ground beam bridges between two separate foundation pads and carries a central upright support.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-foundation-ground-beam","label_en":"Foundation ground beam","label_is":"Sökkulbiti milli undirstaðna","section":"04","category_en":"Excavation, foundations and ground engineering","category_is":"Uppgröftur, undirstöður og jarðtækni","batch":2,"tags":["foundation","ground-beam"],"description":"A reinforced ground beam bridges between two separate foundation pads and carries a central upright support.","design_note":"An open span between isolated pads differentiates the ground beam from a continuously supported strip footing.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
